chose: The record's shape. A turn is the spoken card's turn (a line Kokoro says, or the owner's take by home's id) with an id that lasts across versions and keeps its voice; a segue is one of the agent's turns, not a field on the owner's, since it is the agent's voice and the agent's editorial work; a version plays each take at most once. A flag goes only on a turn of the newest version, in the voice its kind belongs to, and the owner may take it back until the next version. The next version answers every open flag, each once, and says how, from a table keyed by the flag's kind: a rewrite names turns it changed (added, removed, reworded or moved), which may reach past the flagged turn; a retake plays, in the flagged turn, a take the owner gave as a point and the version before didn't play; conditioning plays the same take louder, faster or slower (HOST12); and any flag may be kept, its turn unchanged, with a reason the owner reads. Every turn that changed between the two versions is named by a rewrite or a retake, so the record says why each moved, and a version with no flag to answer changes nothing: a new point reaches a version only through a flag, such as misses-point with a note. Events are kept in the order of their dates. A green light goes only to the newest version with no flag open, and closes the record: the signature is a record of its own, keyed by the green-lit version's turn ids, and a reopened conversation is a new record or a new event in /2.
options: Segues as agent turns; every open flag answered and every change named, keeping allowed with a reason; the green light closes the record (chosen)
A segue as a field on each owner turn
Flags may stay open across versions, the agent answering when it chooses
No keeping: every flag forces a change
The agent may write a new version unprompted, its changes unnamed
A green light the owner can take back within the same record
gray: The issue words a segue as a part of each turn and does not say whether the agent may decline a flag, change turns no flag named, or whether a green light can be undone; the owner meets each of these in Studio's podcast player (HOST14), and no check or earlier call settles them.
